verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada's own pages state that the fastest way to submit an incorporation application and pay is through its Online Filing Centre. They publish the online fee and timing ($200, 1 day, with a 4-hour express option) next to the slower PDF email/mail fallback ($250, 10 days). Annual returns and director changes can also be filed online. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that an online filing was actually completed end to end.
